name: Algeria
summary: Largest nation in Africa by land area with Mediterranean coastal fringe and expansive Saharan interior. Major natural gas producer and exporter to Europe with heavy domestic gas grid dependence.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 7.08x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); persistent airborne Saharan mineral dust across interior regions.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; extreme Saharan heatwaves exceeding 49 °C in Ouargla and Adrar.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: North African warming trend rate of +0.44 °C per decade over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.5% share of global fossil emissions; domestic natural gas flaring reduction programs underway.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: High per capita emission rate within Africa due to heavy domestic gas power and water desalination.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Mediterranean Aleppo pine and cork oak woodlands in Atlas mountains covering ~19,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Grid overwhelmingly powered by domestic natural gas; National Renewable Energy Program scaling solar PV.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 19 people/km²; over 90% of population concentrated in northern coastal strip.
